items.title: Don't take NBA dot com's matchup data as gospel, but it has Michael Porter Jr. as only getting 3 points and 1 shot attempt when guarded by Baylor Scheierman last night.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Don't take NBA dot com's matchup data as gospel, but it has Michael Porter Jr. as only getting 3 points and 1 shot attempt when guarded by Baylor Scheierman last night.

In particular, I thought Scheierman did a good job of denying MPJ off the ball, forcing the Nets to look elsewhere.

items.title: Two flopping technical fouls called in Celtics-Nets and both were good calls. Julius Randle flopped early and then Baylor Scheierman flopped late in the third quarter.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Two flopping technical fouls called in Celtics-Nets and both were good calls. Julius Randle flopped early and then Baylor Scheierman flopped late in the third quarter.

The NBA has been handing out a lot of postgame flopping fines too.

Glad to see them working on removing/penalizing flopping.
